rows.label: tlk70000062_05_msg0001
rows.name:
For us Gulans, Heaven's Holy Grail's
attack on Iira's capital can't be
dismissed as someone else's problem...

rows.label: tlk70000062_05_msg0002
rows.name:
There's the direct damage from
Heaven's Holy Grail, of course, but
foreign invasion worries me even more.

rows.label: tlk70000062_05_msg0003
rows.name:
Superbia and Gula are on good terms,
but honestly, I don't know what the
other countries are thinking.

rows.label: tlk70000062_05_msg0004
rows.name:
Gula is a tribal society made up of
many different tribes...

rows.label: tlk70000062_05_msg0005
rows.name:
And the chiefs of those tribes aren't
exactly united as one.

rows.label: tlk70000062_05_msg0006
rows.name:
I've got a bad feeling about what
would happen if other countries
prodded those brittle ties too hard...
